meta.name: revops
meta.description: When the user wants help with revenue operations, lead lifecycle management, or marketing-to-sales handoff processes. Also use when the user mentions 'RevOps,' 'revenue operations,' 'lead scoring,' 'lead routing,' 'MQL,' 'SQL,' 'pipeline stages,' 'deal desk,' 'CRM automation,' 'marketing-to-sales handoff,' 'data hygiene,' 'leads aren't getting to sales,' 'pipeline management,' 'lead qualification,' or 'when should marketing hand off to sales.' Use this for anything involving the systems and processes that connect marketing to revenue. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For email drip campaigns, see emails. For pricing decisions, see pricing.

copy.tagline: 自动化线索生命周期与营销到销售交接流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责营销到销售的线索交接与管道管理
copy.tagline_en: Automate lead lifecycle and marketing-to-sales handoff processes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage marketing-to-sales handoff and pipeline stages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计营销、销售和客户成功之间的流程，比如定义线索阶段、设置评分规则、建立路由和自动化，并给出可执行的文档。
howto.when: 当你提到“RevOps”、“收入运营”、“线索评分”、“MQL”、“SQL”、“管道阶段”、“CRM自动化”、“营销到销售交接”等关键词，或询问如何优化从营销到收入的系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个MQL到SQL的交接流程，包括SLA。
say.note: Claude会给出阶段定义、响应时间和自动化建议。

say.text: 如何设置线索评分模型？
say.note: Claude会提供评分维度和构建步骤。

say.text: 我的线索路由规则应该怎么定？
say.note: Claude会介绍路由方法并给出决策树建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design and optimize the systems connecting marketing, sales, and customer success, including lead lifecycle stages, scoring, routing, CRM automation, and provides actionable documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'RevOps,' 'revenue operations,' 'lead scoring,' 'MQL,' 'SQL,' 'pipeline stages,' 'CRM automation,' 'marketing-to-sales handoff,' or ask about optimizing revenue-related processes.

say_en.text: Design an MQL-to-SQL handoff process with SLAs.
say_en.note: Claude provides stage definitions, response times, and automation suggestions.

say_en.text: How to set up a lead scoring model?
say_en.note: Claude provides scoring dimensions and build steps.

say_en.text: How should I define lead routing rules?
say_en.note: Claude explains routing methods and suggests a decision tree.
